answers.goal: As a Cognitive Studies and Cinema & Media Arts major, I'm fascinated by both how people think and how stories are created and told. That's why I'm currently exploring UX/UI and product design within the entertainment industry. My goal is to create digital experiences that help people discover, enjoy, and connect with any sorts of entertainment, whether that's through streaming platforms, creative tools, or other entertainment products. I'm still early in my journey, but I know I want to work at the intersection of storytelling, technology, and human-centered design.
answers.drew:
Growing up in Mongolia, global entertainment, especially movies and TV, was one of the main ways I learned English and discovered the world beyond my own. At first, I simply loved watching stories, but over time I became curious about what happens behind the scenes: how ideas become films and shows that connect with people. That curiosity is what drew me to the entertainment industry.

This summer at The Gotham Group, I've been reading script coverage, which has completely changed the way I watch films, and I've also had the chance to work on an independent web UX design project. It made me realize that whether you're designing a digital product or developing a film, you're ultimately thinking about how people experience something—what captures their attention, what makes them feel connected, and what stays with them. I really enjoy being around that mix of storytelling, psychology, creativity, and collaboration, and that's what keeps pulling me toward entertainment.
answers.seeking:
I’m hoping to meet people who are kind, curious, and passionate about creating things. This is my first time in LA, and as someone who came from Mongolia on the other side of the world and now studies in Nashville on the other side of the U.S., it has been both exciting and a little lonely being somewhere so new. I’d love to connect with people I can share experiences and ideas with.

I’m also especially interested in meeting people who share similar goals in the intersection of technology and entertainment. Many of the people around me are pursuing directing or writing, so it would be exciting to meet others who are also thinking about entertainment through design, digital products, and audience experience.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is honestly my future self, the person I hope to become in 10 years. It might sound a little unconventional and self centered, but I like the idea of constantly working toward someone I'll be proud of. I hope she's built a meaningful career, stayed curious, taken risks, and created meaningful things. Thinking about that version of myself reminds me to keep believing in my own potential.
